segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers generally report the product feels light, sinks in without adding shine or greasiness, though one with acne-prone oily skin still lists it among moisturizers that worked well long-term.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers are split: several call it a reliable daily hydrator that clears flaky patches, while others (including one with very dry skin and one with PCOS-related dryness) find it insufficient alone and layer richer products or aquaphor on top.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe it as well-balanced and suited to their skin through different seasons, with one noting she needs a richer product layered underneath in winter.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report no irritation or breakouts (including rosacea and eczema cases), but a minority describe burning, redness, or flare-ups, some tied to niacinamide or other actives.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers value it for softening fine lines and improving glow, though at least one 56-year-old reviewer disliked that it pilled and would not repurchase.
segments.normal: One normal-skin reviewer found it pleasant to use but not hydrating enough to justify repurchase.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers report visibly reduced fine lines and a smoother, more 'glass skin' look after weeks to months of use; one reviewer with anti-aging expectations saw no visible improvement in texture or wrinkles.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the product as effectively relieving dryness and dehydration, clearing flaky or cracked patches, but a few with very dry or dehydrated skin say it is not moisturizing enough on its own, especially in winter.
concerns.redness: One reviewer notes it causes no redness where other moisturizers do, while another reports the product triggered immediate redness and irritation, including flare-ups around the nose and chin.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers managing eczema or a compromised barrier generally report improvement (dry patches and eczema patches resolving), though one reviewer's patch-test-passed skin still reacted with burning and worsened irritation on the face.
concerns.spots: Not enough specific mentions of spots/hyperpigmentation to characterize distinctly beyond general 'skin looks brighter' comments from a couple of reviewers.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and some improvement in smoothness, but multiple reviewers describe new pimples, including large under-the-skin bumps, after starting the product, with one attributing it to comedogenic ingredients and another to the included vitamin C.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers mostly report the product does not add shine or oiliness and controls midday oil-slick look, though one reviewer with normal-to-combination skin found it slightly greasy before fully absorbing.

extraits.texte: At first, moisturizer seemed semi hydrating, but after a few hours, I looked greasy and shiny and it pilled up, I use this for a few days, and it was the direct cause of large, swollen red under the surface pimples that took a while to get rid of, and would not come to head, after looking at the ingredients, I noticed it's got several poor clogging gradients and is very comedogenic. I wish I would've noticed this sooner because those bombs on my pale face were extremely noticeable even with MAKEUP, which made me feel conscious. I will never understand why they put poor clogging ingredients in products SMFH 🤦🏻‍♀️ DO BETTER COMPANIES & LISTEN TO YOUR CONSUMERS🙄🙄🙄 REVIEWS!!!!!

I did a test patch on my forearm before I used this on my face and didn't have a reaction within the next 24 hours. I was excited to try it because the texture reminded me of Dieux's Air Angel moisturizer and that's one of my all time favorites. For some reason when I applied to my face after washing it, no other skincare added, it burned my skin so badly and caused immediate redness and irritation. It started flaring up my PD around my chin and nose badly. It also dries out my face SO badly. I have sensitive normal to dry skin. Bummed I had this reaction to it but it does seem to work for other people, just maybe not for sensitive skin.

This peptide cream is amazing and if my skin wasn't so temperamental I'd rate is a 5 out of 5. I have pcos, and that reflects in how dry and irritated my skin can get. In the summer time this moisturizer leaves my face hydrated and not flaky, however its just not enough right now during this MN winter season. I still love this product nonetheless and have it receive it on auto ship.

extraits.titre: Love this, but could be better for very dry skin
extraits.texte: I'll start off by saying I do really love this moisturizer! It has been the best out of countless others I have tried over the years. Usually whenever I add or switch something in my routine, my skin breaks out before getting used to the new product. With this moisturizer, that did not happen! It has a very nice creamy texture and is great as a day time moisturizer. It feels nice and lightweight on the skin and does not irritate sensitive undereyes. All around great! The only problem I have faced with this moisturizer and all other day time ones, is that it is not moisturizing enough. I have extremely dry skin, so, often I have to put aquaphor on my eyes, nose, and around my mouth on top of my moisturizer for my skin to have a chance of staying hydrated during the day. Nothing wrong with that, just saying if you have very dry skin, don't expect this moisturizer to fix EVERYTHING.

I've been using this moisturizer for about 2 months now and I'm obsessed. It's lightweight but my face doesn't feel dry at the end of the day, and my face looks so much glowier than it did before. I do use it in conjunction with the multi-peptide advanced serum, so i also recommend that, but both have been working great. My skin is sensitive (i have rosacea), but i wouldn't say that it's the MOST sensitive out there if that is helpful to know. I don't react badly to things often, usually just acne if something doesn't agree with me. This has not been a problem for me.

extraits.titre: Amazing moisturizer for aging acne prone skin!
extraits.texte: I have literally never left a product review but I have to for this moisturizer. I'm 32 years old with oily, acne prone skin and this has been a game changer!! It's light weight but moisturizing, never breaks me out and makes my skin so smooth and radiant. I use this morning and night, after serums and is the perfect base for makeup. I have repurchased several times, this will forever be in my skin care routine.

Great price for such goodness for my face. Usually when I apply moisturizer I get an initial redness and then it goes away. I get no redness at all from applying this multi peptides moisturizer to my face. I have to however learn when it comes to my face stick to one and one being just this one. It's great. I highly recommend it and the eye cream too. Get both
